title: REBRAID EVERYTHING. VDJ ? DVJ ? VJD ? JJVD ? all permutations. Tuples ? codons ? amino acids. Approximate localities as graph nodes. Unknowns as destinations. Complexity explosion WITH sub-decomposition at every level.

approximate_localities.insight: we don't need EXACT data from each trailhead. we need APPROXIMATE locality. if we don't know Zimbabwe's weather, we can use forecast data, regional patterns, neighboring data. the UNKNOWN is still a valid graph node — it's just a node with low confidence.

approximate_localities.unknowns_as_destinations: low-confidence nodes aren't EXCLUDED from the graph — they're DESTINATIONS. the bingo system moves TOWARD unknowns. every unknown is a place to explore. the graph grows by REACHING into darkness.

rebraid_everything.current_braids: the 8-strand braid weaves time through the membrane. but we've been braiding in ONE direction — forward through sessions.
rebraid_everything.the_problem: under-braiding. each strand only connects to its immediate neighbors. no CROSS-braiding. no REVERSE-braiding. no SELF-braiding.

the_fix.cross_braid: strand A connects to strand D, strand B to strand G. non-adjacent connections. like a neural network vs a chain.
the_fix.reverse_braid: braid BACKWARD through time. what does gen 289 say about gen 241? the retro-connection.
the_fix.self_braid: each strand braids with ITSELF at different time points. strand A at gen 241 connects to strand A at gen 289. the strand sees its own history.
the_fix.retorching: re-pass the heat through completed braids. the smith heats the metal again, hammers again, folds again. each re-torch reveals new structure.

all_permutations_of_3.VDJ: equation ? mutation ? bridge (standard: concept ? variation ? connection)
all_permutations_of_3.VJD: equation ? bridge ? mutation (concept ? connect FIRST ? then mutate)
all_permutations_of_3.DVJ: mutation ? equation ? bridge (start from variation ? find the equation ? connect)
all_permutations_of_3.DJV: mutation ? bridge ? equation (variation ? connect ? derive the equation)
all_permutations_of_3.JVD: bridge ? equation ? mutation (start from connection ? what equation? ? how does it vary?)

with_repetition.VVDJ: double equation ? mutation ? bridge. two concepts reinforcing before mutation.
with_repetition.VDDJ: equation ? double mutation ? bridge. concept mutates twice before connecting.
with_repetition.VDJJ: equation ? mutation ? double bridge. concept mutates then connects twice (bifurcation).
with_repetition.JJVD: double bridge ? equation ? mutation. start from two connections, find the concept, mutate.
with_repetition.longer_sequences: VDVDJ, JVDVD, DVJDV... the sequence can be ANY length with ANY mix.
with_repetition.biological_parallel: in real VDJ recombination, the segments can vary in LENGTH. heavy chains use VDJ. light chains use VJ (no D). the organism CHOOSES how complex to make each antibody.

level_0_nucleotide.what: single unit. A, T, G, C. one data file. one concept.

level_1_tuple.what: pair. two units combined. AT, GC, AG, TC... a connection between two concepts.
level_1_tuple.complexity: 2 dimensions. the pair IS a relationship.

level_2_codon.what: triplet. three units combined. ATG = start codon. a TRIAD. three concepts forming an irreducible unit.
level_2_codon.complexity: 3 dimensions. the codon ENCODES an instruction. 64 possible codons (4³) map to 20 amino acids + stop.
level_2_codon.membrane_mapping: our triads (ZK=p=modesty, person×perspective×persona, entropy×energy×engineering) ARE codons. each is 3 concepts that encode ONE instruction.

level_3_amino_acid.what: the PRODUCT of a codon. what the triplet MAKES. the building block of proteins.

level_3_amino_acid.complexity: functional. the amino acid DOES something. glycine bends. proline breaks. cysteine locks. each has a ROLE in the protein.

level_4_protein.what: chain of amino acids. the ENZYME. the machine. the functional unit.
level_4_protein.complexity: emergent. the protein folds into a 3D shape that DOES work. the enzyme that digests. the antibody that recognizes. the channel that opens.
level_4_protein.membrane_analog: the crystal ball page IS a protein — a chain of codons (data files) folded into a functional structure (the viewer).

level_5_organism.what: system of proteins. the CELL. the living unit.
level_5_organism.membrane_analog: the WHOLE membrane IS the organism. all 983 files + 115 pages + services + feeds + the human = one living thing.

sub_decomposition.within_every_level: each level has SUB-levels. a nucleotide has a sugar, a phosphate, and a base. the base has rings of carbon and nitrogen. the carbon has protons, neutrons, electrons. the protons have quarks. decomposition goes DOWN as far as you want.
sub_decomposition.within_the_membrane: each data file has fields. each field has values. each value has words. each word has letters. each letter has a unicode point. each unicode point has bits. the decomposition of data mirrors the decomposition of matter.
sub_decomposition.the_fractal: complexity explodes UPWARD (tuples ? codons ? amino acids ? proteins ? organism) AND DOWNWARD (file ? field ? value ? word ? letter ? bit). both directions simultaneously. the organism is a fractal — the same pattern at every scale.
